children: Most JGBs rise in the Tokyo session, tracking price gains in U.S. Treasurys. Both JGBs and Treasurys tend to move in tandem. Japanese and U.S. bond markets were closed for a public holiday on Monday. The 10-year JGB yield is down 1 bp at 3.000%, the 30-year yield is down 1 bp at 4.045%, while the 2-year yield is up 1 bp at 1.915%, according to data provider Quick. Yield on U.S. 10-year Treasurys is down 5 bps to 5.195% and yield on 30-year Treasurys is 4 bps lower at 5.555%, FactSet data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
